<!doctype html><html lang="sk"><head><meta charset="utf-8" /><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no" /><meta name="theme-color" placeholder="Adresa, mesto, firma alebo bod záujmu"/><button id="searchBtn" class="btn">Hľadať</button></div><small id="searchStatus"></small><div id="searchResults" class="results"></div></div><div id="gpsNotice" class="gpsnotice"><b>GPS</b><span>Získavam GPS polohu…</span></div><details class="fold"><summary><span class="foldtitle"><b>Waze routing</b><small id="routingStatus">známka zap.</small></span><span class="foldchev">›</span></summary><div class="foldbody"><label><span>Diaľničná známka / subscription</span><input id="useVignette" type="checkbox" type="checkbox" checked></label><div class="chips"><button class="chip active" data-voice="soft">Jemný ženský</button><button class="chip" data-voice="clear">Jasný ženský</button></div><button id="voiceTest" class="btn wide">Vyskúšať hlas</button></div></details><details class="fold"><summary><span class="foldtitle"><b>Nabíjačky</b><small id="chargerStatus">vyp.</small></span><span class="foldchev">›</span></summary><div class="foldbody"><button id="chargerToggle" class="btn wide">Nabíjačky vyp.</button><div id="chargerControls" class="hidden"><div class="chips" id="chargerFilters"></div><button id="chargerSearch" class="btn wide">Hľadať v tejto oblasti</button><small id="chargerMsg"></small></div></div></details><details class="fold music-fold"><summary><span class="foldtitle"><b>🎵 Hudba</b><small>Smart Music</small></span><span class="foldchev">›</span></summary><div class="foldbody"><button id="openMusic" class="btn wide primary">Otvoriť prehrávač</button><small id="musicMiniStatus">lukaslejko@gmail.com · YouTube nepripojený</small></div></details><details class="fold"><summary><span class="foldtitle"><b>Obľúbené miesta</b><small id="favCount">0</small></span><span class="foldchev">›</span></summary><div id="favorites" class="foldbody"></div></details><details class="fold"><summary><span class="foldtitle"><b>Posledné ciele</b><small id="recentCount">0</small></span><span class="foldchev">›</span></summary><div id="recents" class="foldbody"></div></details></aside><section class="mapwrap"><div id="map" class="map"></div><div class="topbar"><button id="panelBtn" class="btn">Skryť panel</button><button id="routeModeBtn" class="btn hidden">Celá trasa</button><div id="speed" class="badge">— km/h</div><button id="fullscreenBtn" class="btn">Celá obrazovka</button></div><div id="routeBox" class="routebox hidden"></div><div id="alertBox" class="alertbox
